A.finding: Free-streaming transition scale is ~0.01-0.1 h/Mpc. Below this scale, PAC dilation applies to collapsed/interacting matter.

B.finding: Scale-dependent PAC dilation: negligible at large scales (free-streaming), significant at small scales (interacting). Transition at k ~ 0.01-0.1 h/Mpc.

C.finding: PAC dilation boosts small-scale power by ~(Xi-1) ~ 5.8%, with transition at free-streaming scale. Consistent with JWST excess.

D.finding: PAC dilation shifts BAO scale by ~2.9% (below current precision). Shifts H_0 toward SH0ES but doesn't solve the tension.

E.finding: 5 testable predictions. S8 tension direction matches PAC. JWST excess consistent. BAO shift below current precision.

synthesis.mechanism: Scale-dependent PAC dilation from free-streaming exemption
falsifiable_by: BAO r_s shifts away from prediction
JWST masses explained by standard astrophysics
synthesis.verdict: Quantitative, falsifiable predictions. Consistent with current cosmological tensions. Testable by upcoming surveys.
